_doc: Declared audit posture for every AuditAction (src/types/auditActionTypes.ts).
check:clinical-mutation-audit-policy fails if any AuditAction is not classified here,
or if a best-effort entry lacks a justification. This makes 'how is this mutation audited'
an explicit, reviewed decision instead of an accident. See
- failClosed: the mutation MUST abort if its audit cannot be written (anonymous actor or
audit error). Reserved for admin overwrites / deletions where an unaudited change is
unacceptable AND aborting is safe (non-urgent, reversible).
- bestEffortObservable: the mutation proceeds even if the audit fails, but the failure is
surfaced (degraded ApplicationOutcome, telemetry, or local-first audit self-observed in
auditCore). Reserved for urgent clinical-flow actions where aborting would impede care.
- exemptNonMutation: views, auth, output/export and system events that do not mutate
clinical state, so no fail-closed audit is required.

bestEffortObservable.justification: Automatic conflict-resolution recovery path; blocking the merge on an audit failure is worse than proceeding. The caller telemeters the failure (dailyRecordConflictAutoMergeController).

Local-first audit (recorded locally, remote sync best-effort and self-observed in auditCore); audited before the identity mutation. True fail-closed would require routing this batch through executeWriteAuditEvent (follow-up).
Admin batch data-maintenance via the local-first audit path; the audit precedes/accompanies the backfill and is self-observed.
Bulk admin restore from backup; aborting a restore on an audit hiccup is worse than an observable best-effort audit.
Urgent clinical-flow action; aborting an admission on an audit failure would impede care. Audit failure is surfaced as a degraded ApplicationOutcome.
Urgent clinical-flow action; aborting a discharge on an audit failure would impede care. Audit failure surfaced as a degraded outcome.
Urgent clinical-flow action; aborting a transfer on an audit failure would impede care. Audit failure surfaced as a degraded outcome.
High-frequency census edit via the local-first audit path; aborting charting on an audit hiccup is worse than an observable best-effort audit.
